verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is an AI assistant with agents, so supervising or embedding coding agents is a fair axis. The evidence pack never shows it running or orchestrating coding agents that clone repos, edit files or run tests. Custom agent skills, MCP compatibility and agent flows are generic building blocks or adjacent features, not documented repo-work capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat
